blocks.text: Welcome to NihongoTracker ("we," "our," or "us"). We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our Japanese immersion tracking platform.
By using NihongoTracker, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. Please also review our [Terms of Service](/terms) which govern your use of our platform.
Information You Provide to Us

blocks.heading: Account Information:
items: Username
Email address (optional, for Patreon linking)
Password (encrypted and hashed)
Discord ID (optional, for external integrations)

blocks.heading: Profile Information:
items: Avatar image
Banner image
Profile customization settings (themes, preferences)
Timezone settings

blocks.heading: Immersion Data:
items: Logs of your Japanese immersion activities (anime, manga, visual novels, books, videos, audio)
Media titles and metadata
Time spent, pages read, episodes watched, characters read
Personal notes and tags on your logs
Goals and progress tracking data

blocks.heading: Patreon Information (Optional):
items: Patreon email address (for benefit verification)
Patreon ID (provided by Patreon webhook)
Subscription tier information
Subscription status

blocks.text: Information Collected Automatically

blocks.heading: Usage Data:
items: IP address
Browser type and version
Device information
Pages visited and features used
Date and time of access
Referral source

blocks.heading: Cookies and Similar Technologies:
items: Authentication tokens (for keeping you logged in)
Theme preferences
Session data

blocks.heading: Core Functionality
items: Provide and maintain the NihongoTracker service
Create and manage your account
Track and display your immersion progress
Calculate XP, levels, and streaks
Generate statistics and visualizations
Enable comparison and ranking features

blocks.heading: Community Features
items: Display public profiles and leaderboards
Enable club functionality and social interactions
Show shared logs and media activity

blocks.heading: Patreon Integration
items: Verify your Patreon subscription status
Apply appropriate benefits based on your tier
Process supporter badges and premium features

blocks.text: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information only in the following circumstances:
Public Information

items: Username
Avatar and banner
Public immersion statistics (total XP, level, streaks)
Public logs (if you choose to make them public)
Club memberships
blocks.intro: The following information is publicly visible on your profile:

blocks.text: Third-Party Services
AniList API:
We use AniList to fetch anime and manga metadata. We may send search queries based on your logged media. No personal information is shared with AniList.
VNDB API:
We use VNDB to fetch visual novel metadata. We may send search queries based on your logged media. No personal information is shared with VNDB.
YouTube Data API:
We use YouTube API to fetch video metadata. We may send video IDs based on your logged media. No personal information is shared with YouTube.
Firebase Storage:
We use Firebase to store uploaded images (avatars, banners). Images are stored securely and accessed only by our application. Google's privacy policy applies to Firebase services.
Patreon:

If you link your Patreon account, we share your Patreon email with Patreon's servers to verify your subscription. We receive webhook notifications about your subscription status. Patreon's privacy policy applies to their services.

items: **Encryption:** Passwords are hashed using bcrypt
**HTTPS:** All data transmission is encrypted using SSL/TLS
**Access Control:** Limited access to personal data by authorized personnel only
**Regular Backups:** Database backups to prevent data loss
**Security Monitoring:** Regular security audits and monitoring
blocks.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information:

blocks.text: However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your personal information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.
You have the following rights regarding your personal information:

blocks.heading: Access and Portability
items: View all your personal data through your profile and settings
Export your immersion logs (feature coming soon)

blocks.heading: Correction and Update
items: Update your profile information at any time through Settings
Correct or edit your immersion logs

blocks.heading: Deletion
items: Delete individual logs or specific data
Delete your entire account and all associated data through Settings → Clear All Data
Once deleted, data cannot be recovered

blocks.heading: Privacy Controls
items: Control which logs are public or private
Opt out of displaying adult content
Unlink external integrations (Discord, Patreon)

blocks.text: NihongoTracker is not intended for children under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can delete it.
We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our service and store certain information.

blocks.heading: Essential Cookies:

blocks.heading: Preference Cookies:

blocks.text: You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our service.

blocks.intro: NihongoTracker offers optional premium subscriptions that provide additional features and benefits. Our subscription tiers are:

blocks.text: For detailed information about what each tier includes, please visit our [Support page](/support).

NihongoTracker's core features are free to use. Premium subscriptions do not include a free trial period. We encourage you to explore our free features before subscribing to understand the value our premium tiers provide.

You have the right to withdraw from your subscription within **30 calendar days** of the charge, without giving any reason and without penalty, in accordance with Law No. 358-05 on the General Protection of Consumer or User Rights of the Dominican Republic, which grants this right for distance contracts, including contracts concluded over the internet.
We offer this right to **all users**, wherever you live. We do not check your location, and the same 30-day period applies to everyone.
3.1 How to Exercise It

items: An email to [support@nihongotracker.app](mailto:support@nihongotracker.app)
The model withdrawal form in Section 3.3 below — using it is optional
Any other written communication in which your decision is clear

4.2 Goodwill Refunds Outside That Period

Separately from the legal right above, we operate a **voluntary goodwill policy** for requests made after the 30-day withdrawal period has passed. This policy is additional to your legal right of withdrawal and does not limit it in any way.

items: Technical issues that prevented you from using premium features

alwaysFree.question: Will NihongoTracker always be free?
alwaysFree.answer: Yes! Core features will always remain free. Premium tiers unlock additional features and customization options, but you'll always be able to track your immersion, view stats, and compete on leaderboards for free.

benefits.question: How do I get my supporter benefits?
benefits.answer: After becoming a Patreon supporter, link your Patreon account in your settings. Benefits will be automatically applied to your account within 24 hours.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Absolutely. You can cancel your Patreon membership at any time, and you'll keep your benefits until the end of your current billing period.
